meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤引导你完成 AI Runway 在 AKS 集群上的设置：检查集群、装控制器、评估 GPU、配推理工具，最后部署并验证首个 AI 模型。
howto.when: 当你说出“setup AI Runway”、“install AI Runway”、“deploy model to AKS”等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 AI Runway 到这个 AKS 集群。
say.note: Claude 会从检查集群开始逐步设置。

say.text: 我想在 AKS 上跑 vLLM 模型。
say.note: Claude 会引导部署模型到集群。

say.text: 检查这个集群的 GPU 能不能跑大模型？
say.note: Claude 会检测 GPU 并报告兼容性。

howto.what_en: Claude will walk you through setting up AI Runway on AKS: check cluster, install controller, assess GPUs, configure provider, then deploy and verify a model.
